colorways.name: Coral and driftwood
colorways.oneLine: Closest to today's look, sun-washed: peach-warm sand paper, espresso-brown words, and your coral softened toward clay so it feels like terracotta, not a warning light.
colorways.fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale sand (#d1ccc0) lifted lighter and warmed with the peach of skin (#e1b59c); text from the darkest driftwood brown (#382417) taken deeper; the button is today's coral pulled toward the clay and driftwood browns (#a57c54, #866340); the second color is the peach of skin in warm light (#e1b59c); good and heads up come from the olive (#767f63) and the mustard (#d8ac4b), each darkened so it reads as text; late is a berry from the dusty rose (#a97d79), kept well away from the coral so the main button never looks like a warning.

colorways.name: Palm and sand
colorways.oneLine: Like standing in the shade of a palm on a pale beach: sand paper with a breath of green in it, deep forest-black words, and one calm green for the thing you press.
colorways.fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the sand and soft-white tones (#ddddda, #d1ccc0) lifted lighter, with a little of the olive (#767f63) in them; text from the forest-black of the lava rock and deep foliage (#1b2119, #2f362b); the button green from the palm and olive leaves (#767f63), deepened so white words read on it; the second color is the mustard of your overlay text (#d8ac4b); good is a sea green from the deep ocean (#305c72), so a status never looks like the brand green; extras are the ocean, peach skin, driftwood and dusty rose.

colorways.name: Sea and driftwood
colorways.oneLine: Like a hazy morning at the water: cool pale stone paper, lava-black words, a dusty sea blue for the button, and peach skin tones for warmth.
colorways.fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale stone (#f3f4f5, #ddddda) with the second background a breath of sea haze (#8fa8b6); text from the black lava rock, kept warm and never blue (#0c0f0a blended with #382417); the button blue from the ocean (between #638da4 and #305c72, so it stays dusty and never navy); the second color is the peach of skin in warm light (#e1b59c); the optional dark band is warm lava; extras are mustard, olive, sky and driftwood.

colorways.name: Gold hour sand
colorways.oneLine: Late-afternoon beach light: buttery bone paper, lava-black words, and the mustard gold from your overlay text as the button. This is the one colorway where the button is light with dark words on it.
colorways.fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the sand tones (#d1ccc0, #ddddda) lifted lighter and warmed toward the mustard; text from the lava and forest-black (#1b2119) warmed with espresso (#382417); the button is the mustard of your overlay text (#d8ac4b) taken a step deeper so it stands off the page, with a darker gold edge and dark words on it; the second color is the hazy ocean (#8fa8b6) made paler, with deep ocean (#305c72) words; good is the olive (#767f63) darkened, heads up is driftwood brown (#866340) so it never looks like the brand gold, late the clay-rose (#a97d79) deepened.
